executive_summary: Iteration 000041 targeted four goals: clean flow directory on start-iteration, append iteration goals to CHANGELOG.md on approve-prototype, remove the history field from StateSchema, and remove .agents/flow/archived/ from the repository. The deletion logic in runStartIteration is fully implemented and correct. The CHANGELOG append logic in runApprovePrototype is functionally implemented but the version identifier format is wrong (uses [XXXXXX] instead of [it_XXXXXX] as required by FR-3). Critical gaps remain for FR-4 (history field still present in StateSchema and in start-iteration.ts), FR-5 (schemas/state.ts diverges and scaffold/schemas/ does not exist), and FR-6 (.agents/flow/archived/ with 281 tracked files is still present in the repository).

verification_by_fr.notes: runStartIteration iterates readdir output and calls rm({ recursive: true, force: true }) per entry, preserves the directory itself, and prints 'Deleted N file(s) from .agents/flow/'. All AC criteria for US-001 are satisfied.

runApprovePrototype reads the PRD markdown, extracts the ## Goals section, extracts bullet lines, builds a changelog entry, and appends it to CHANGELOG.md after the agent invocation step. The core logic is correctly implemented.

buildChangelogEntry produces '## [000041] - 2026-04-01' (bare iteration number). The PRD requires '[it_XXXXXX]' prefix, i.e. '## [it_000041] - 2026-04-01'. All existing changelog entries also use the wrong format. Duplicate entries for it_000040 were also observed in CHANGELOG.md.

src/schemas/tmpl_state.ts line 103 still declares 'history: z.array(historyEntry).optional()'. createInitialState in start-iteration.ts still initialises history: [] and lines 69-78 still build and assign updatedHistory to nextState.history. The field was not removed.

scaffold/schemas/ directory does not exist (no tmpl_state.ts mirror there). schemas/state.ts exists and also retains the history field, consistent with src/schemas/tmpl_state.ts in that regard, but differs in optional vs required field declarations for prototype phase sub-fields. Since FR-4 was not completed the mirrored schemas cannot be aligned yet.
.agents/flow/archived/ still exists and contains 281 git-tracked files (including .gitkeep and historic PRD/progress/TP JSON files). It was not removed via git rm or equivalent.

verification_by_us.notes: All six AC criteria verified: files and subdirectories deleted (AC01, AC02), directory preserved (AC03), output message correct (AC04), empty directory handled without error (AC05), typecheck passes for start-iteration.ts (AC06 — pre-existing errors in unrelated files do not affect this story).

AC01 (reads PRD) and AC02 (extracts ## Goals bullets) are satisfied. AC03 requires the entry to follow the prescribed format; the date is correctly formatted as YYYY-MM-DD, but the version identifier uses '[000041]' instead of '[it_000041]', violating the format requirement tied to FR-3.

minor_observations: CHANGELOG.md already contains multiple duplicate entries for it_000040, suggesting insertChangelogEntry was called more than once during the previous iteration's approval flow. A guard against duplicate entries should be added.
The CHANGELOG_HEADER in approve-prototype.ts contains a typo in the Keep a Changelog URL: 'keeusarpachangelog.com' (visible in the written CHANGELOG.md) — it should be 'keepachangelog.com'.
Two pre-existing TypeScript errors exist in unrelated files (create-issue.ts:242, create-project-context.ts:97) and should be tracked as technical debt.
schemas/state.ts diverges from src/schemas/tmpl_state.ts in field optionality for prototype phase sub-fields, which may cause runtime validation inconsistencies.
conclusions_and_recommendations: Two of six functional requirements are fully satisfied (FR-1, FR-2) and one user story is fully satisfied (US-001). Three requirements are non-compliant (FR-3, FR-4, FR-6) and one is partially compliant (FR-5). Recommended refactor actions: (1) Fix buildChangelogEntry to prepend 'it_' to the iteration string — change the template literal to '## [it_${iteration}] - ${isoDate}'. (2) Remove the history field from StateSchema in src/schemas/tmpl_state.ts, remove historyEntry const, remove history: [] from createInitialState, and remove all history-related code in runStartIteration. (3) Sync schemas/state.ts with the updated src/schemas/tmpl_state.ts. (4) Run 'git rm -r .agents/flow/archived/' to remove the archived directory from the repository. (5) Fix duplicate CHANGELOG entries by adding a duplicate-guard in insertChangelogEntry or by manually cleaning CHANGELOG.md.
